$comment: Test scenarios of Taoist (3161035078) ModMain/Mod. kind: auto = run by AutoTestEvent (TT title, TG game, TB code-started battles, TX time-changing), watch = run automatically while the tester plays a battle (-WatchBattles), manual = steps for a human tester. Auto/watch ids must match AutoTest/AutoTestScenarios.cs. exclusive: changes the global settings of the mods (run-autotest-parallel.ps1 runs it alone, after the others). Docs: docs/Taoist/03-Test-Scenarios.md

scenarios.title: Title screen shows Taoist/ModLib buttons and versions are compatible
scenarios.description: Smoke test of the mod installation. On the title screen Taoist adds its own buttons (Taoist version, S&M configs) and ModLib adds its buttons. If they are missing the mods did not load; if ModLib is older than the version Taoist needs, a warning would appear. Passes when all buttons are there and no warning is shown.
scenarios.preconditions: Game started with ModLib and Taoist enabled
expected: ModLib, Taoist and S&M buttons are on the title screen
No 'not supported in ModLib' warning (ModLib >= MODLIB_REQUIRED_VERSION)

scenarios.title: S&M configs window: 3 pages, presets and cancel
scenarios.description: S&M (Settings & Modes) is the global Taoist settings window opened from the title screen: game speed, NPC amount, difficulty presets, etc. The test pages through the window, clicks a difficulty preset to check that the total difficulty score is recalculated, then presses Cancel to check that nothing is saved. Page 3 holds the toggles of the additional features (encounters, bank loans, buy orders, bounties); they do not change the difficulty score.
steps: Look at page 1, go to page 2
expected: Valid saved values (GrowUpSpeed >= 1, NPCAmount > 0, StartupPlayerRole in range)

scenarios.title: New game: difficulty and character creation screens
scenarios.description: Taoist changes the new-game screens: the vanilla difficulty descriptions are replaced, and the S&M option 'priority destiny level' makes destinies of a chosen level appear first when creating a character. The test opens both screens (no character is created) and checks those two behaviours.
steps: Set PriorityDestinyLevel=2 and open the character creation screen
expected: Level-2 destinies are prioritised in the creation screen

scenarios.title: ModLib title: language selector and tools
scenarios.description: ModLib's own additions to the title screen: a language selector and a tools window (with the list of config ids defined twice by several mods). The test only checks that these open.

scenarios.title: S&M configs: OK without change keeps every value
scenarios.description: Opening the global S&M configs and pressing OK without touching anything must keep every value: each control has to save into the same field it was built from (NoMarketItem and NoStalker were built from NoExpFromBattles, so OK silently overwrote them). The global config file is written.

scenarios.title: Create a new character (trainer on, CrueltyShura, 3 artifacts, intro skipped)
scenarios.description: Pre-test: creates a new character for the run in a free save slot (never over an existing save), with the S&M trainer on and the highest difficulty (CrueltyShura). Every other scenario then runs on it, from the same starting state on every run; the created save is removed by the restore after the run. Skipped with -Save / -ExistingSave / -ManualLoad (existing save).
scenarios.preconditions: Title screen, a free save slot
steps: Turn the S&M trainer on (global configs)
Open the save list, find a free slot
Difficulty CrueltyShura, amount of NPCs Sparse (faster world creation); character creation, NewGameEvent: tick the 3 divine artifacts + skip intro, OK
Wait for the world (no intro drama / first battle expected)
expected: New save loaded on the map
Trainer on in the save configs, TrainerEvent loaded
Bagua Jade, God Eye and Devil Demon pot active; no intro screen and no first battle

scenarios.title: Taoist settings and events are loaded in the save
scenarios.description: First check after the save is loaded: Taoist read its settings file (mod_configs.json) and created all its feature objects (events). Optional features (Trainer, Qi cultivation, natural upgrade, artifact repair) must exist only when enabled in S&M. If this fails, most other TG scenarios are meaningless.
expected: Optional events (Trainer, QiCul, UpgradeNaturally, RepairShinki) loaded only when enabled in S&M configs

scenarios.title: Per-save S&M configs exist and Calculate applies rates
scenarios.description: Each save has its own copy of the S&M settings. Many Taoist features scale a value by an S&M rate through Calculate(value, rate). The test checks the copy exists and that Calculate(100, +50%) = 150, (100, 0%) = 100, (100, -50%) = 50.

scenarios.title: Nearest-units option limits the units used by Taoist events
scenarios.description: Performance option 'All functions apply to nearest units': when on, Taoist's monthly NPC logic only processes NPCs within 3 areas of the player instead of the whole world. The test turns the option on (temporarily), rebuilds the NPC list and checks no far NPC is in it.
scenarios.preconditions: Save loaded (the option is switched on temporarily when off)
expected: Only units within +-3 areas of the player

scenarios.title: World price index is applied to prices
scenarios.description: Inflation: Taoist keeps a world price index that grows every year and multiplies prices. The test checks the saved index equals the game economy index, is in a sane range, and that CalculateInflationary(1000) applies it while negative values stay unchanged.

scenarios.title: Units receive a role
scenarios.description: Every unit (player and NPCs) gets a role (e.g. merchant, trainee, apprentice...) that gives a luck/bonus. The test checks that units have a role and that the player has the luck of its role.
scenarios.preconditions: Save loaded (on a new save the monthly handler is run once)
expected: Player and NPCs have a role
Player has the luck of its role

scenarios.title: NPC without full exp gains exp monthly
scenarios.description: NPCs that are not at full cultivation exp gain exp automatically every month (so the world does not fall behind the player). The test runs the monthly NPC handler once for one NPC and checks its exp went up.
scenarios.preconditions: An NPC without full exp exists
steps: Run the monthly NPC handler once for that NPC

scenarios.title: Expertise exp formulas
scenarios.description: Expertise: using a martial skill in battle raises an expertise level that gives bonuses. The test checks the exp needed per level (0/1000/2000/4000) and that adding exp works (on a temporary id, removed afterwards).
expected: Exp is added (temporary id removed afterwards)

scenarios.title: Refine exp API
scenarios.description: Custom refine: items refined at a small-town forge gain refine exp. The test calls the API directly: invalid inputs are rejected and 100 + 50 exp gives 150.

scenarios.title: Hire and dismiss a team member
scenarios.description: Hire people: the player can hire an NPC into a team for a monthly salary. The test hires a free NPC by code, checks price/reputation and monthly payment are positive, then dismisses it and checks it left the team.
expected: NPC in the team, monthly payment > 0

scenarios.title: Town budget add/remove and taxes
scenarios.description: Each town has a budget (money) that receives taxes and pays for things (buying from the player, rebuilding). The test adds 12345 to a town budget, removes it again, and checks taxes are not negative.
steps: Add 12345 to the budget then remove it

scenarios.title: Bank account fee is positive for every area
scenarios.description: Bank account: to use a town storage the player must open an account in that area for a fee. The test checks the fee is positive for every area.

scenarios.title: Storage fee rate and storage value
scenarios.description: Real storage: items kept in the storage cost a monthly fee based on their value; unpaid fees become debt. The test checks fee rate, storage value and debt are valid numbers.
steps: Read fee rate, storage value, debt

scenarios.title: Shop sell/buy rates exist for every market town
scenarios.description: Real market: shops buy from / sell to the player at a rate that differs per town. The test checks every market town has positive sell and buy rates.

scenarios.title: Player market listings and VIP price are consistent
scenarios.description: Player market: the player can list items for sale to NPCs (VIP market costs money). The test checks existing listings have positive prices and VIP costs are positive.

scenarios.title: Sect exchange ratio is positive
scenarios.description: Sect contribution exchange: items can be exchanged for sect contribution at a ratio that changes monthly. The test checks the ratio is positive and stays within 80%-130% of the base.

scenarios.title: Original buildings are known and building costs are valid
scenarios.description: Building arrange: Taoist remembers the original buildings of each town (to rebuild them later) and has a cost for each building. The test checks that list is filled and costs are valid.

scenarios.title: Unit modifiers are hooked and bonuses are not negative
scenarios.description: Unit modify: Taoist adds stat bonuses (Atk/Def/HP/MP, and Qi bonuses) to units through a hook. The test checks the player is hooked and no bonus is negative (Qi part skipped when Qi cultivation is off).
expected: Qi bonus >= 0 (SKIP when Qi is off)

scenarios.title: Block table and damage multiplier rules
scenarios.description: Battle modify: blocking reduces damage by a ratio per grade, and damage multipliers make fights harder. The test checks the block table has 10 non-decreasing grades and multipliers are above 1.

scenarios.title: Mana shield of the player
scenarios.description: Mana shield: in battle the player (and humans) get a shield that absorbs damage, computed from MP. The test computes the player's shield and checks the values are sane.

scenarios.title: Monster growth counters exist
scenarios.description: Monsters stronger: monsters get stronger over time / with kills, tracked by counters per monster type. The test checks the Common/Elite/BOSS/NPC counters exist.

scenarios.title: Quest chains have a consistent state
scenarios.description: Quest chains: the slice-of-life quest (months without fighting) and the challenge quest (beat stronger opponents) keep a level and a current task. The test checks the saved state is consistent (levels in range, current task exists).

scenarios.title: Rebirth state and luck
scenarios.description: Rebirth: the player can be reborn (grade reset) to get a permanent luck. The test checks the saved rebirth data is valid and the luck exists when the player was reborn at least once.

scenarios.title: Running commissions are consistent
scenarios.description: Commissions: the player can post a commission at the bounty board (NPCs gather items for a reward). The test checks no running commission is past its deadline and success rates are 0..100%.

scenarios.title: Map screen shows Taoist buttons and hides vanilla widgets
scenarios.description: Map screen UI: Taoist adds 'skip 1 year' / 'skip 10 years' buttons and hides some vanilla widgets (e.g. add-luck). The test looks at the map screen and checks both.

scenarios.title: Cultivation screen shows Qi and cultivation buttons
scenarios.description: Cultivation (fate feature) screen: Taoist shows the player's Qi and its Atk/Hp/Mp bonuses and adds buttons (cultivate with spirit stones, natural upgrade). The test opens the screen and checks they are visible.
expected: Qi/Atk/Hp/Mp texts and cultivation buttons visible

scenarios.title: Game menu save/reload buttons follow the S&M configs
scenarios.description: Game menu (Esc): S&M can hide the Save and Reload buttons (hardcore mode). The test opens the menu and checks the buttons are hidden exactly when the options say so.
expected: Save/Reload buttons hidden exactly when HideSaveButton/HideReloadButton

scenarios.title: Game settings: Taoist settings window and Taoist log
scenarios.description: Game settings show the Taoist settings button, which opens the large Taoist settings window: hide damage multiplier, hide exception logs, market notifications, random encounters, a hint that the artifact hotkeys are in the Bindings tab, and the Taoist log button which opens the log (pages, newest first).
expected: Large window with 4 toggles, log button and hotkey hint
Log window with pages and the newest entry

scenarios.title: Trainer: all pages open and an action changes the player
scenarios.description: Trainer: a cheat window (money, items, properties...) for testing. The test opens every page and uses 'add money' to check an action really changes the player.
scenarios.preconditions: Map screen (when the trainer is disabled, its window is tested with a temporary instance)

scenarios.title: Disabled features have no Instance (BUG-16)
scenarios.description: Known bug BUG-16 (docs/Known-Issues.md): a feature switched off in S&M should not be usable, but its static Instance is still created, so other code can still call it. This test reproduces the bug and is EXPECTED to be NG until BUG-16 is fixed.
scenarios.preconditions: At least one optional feature disabled (Trainer, Qi, UpgradeNaturally)
steps: Read the static Instance of disabled features
expected: Instance is null (NG until BUG-16 is fixed)

scenarios.title: Enter the town: town UI with Taoist info
scenarios.description: Entering a town: Taoist shows its info in the town UI (budget, master, etc.). The test enters the town and checks the town UI opens without error.

scenarios.title: Town storage: open a bank account
scenarios.description: Bank account in the town storage (UI part of TG-11): without an account the storage button is replaced by 'Open account (fee)'. The test clicks it and checks the fee went from the player to the town budget and the storage becomes usable.
scenarios.preconditions: Test save in a town without account
expected: Fee moved from the player to the town budget, account registered

scenarios.title: Bounty board: commission and hire people
scenarios.description: Bounty board: Taoist adds 'Commission' (post a job) and 'Hire People' (hire NPCs). The test checks both buttons and that each opens its window.
expected: Hire list opens (flag reset on close)

scenarios.title: Town market: player market buttons and listings
scenarios.description: Town market: Taoist adds the player-market buttons (VIP Market, Market, My Items, Register). The test checks they exist and that 'Market' opens the listings.
scenarios.preconditions: Test save in a town with market
expected: VIP Market, Market, My Items, Register buttons

scenarios.title: Shop: town budget and buy price rate
scenarios.description: Shop: Taoist shows the town budget ('Market: x Spirit Stones') and the current buy price rate. The test opens the shop and checks those texts and that the rate is in range.
scenarios.preconditions: Test save in a town with shop
expected: 'Market: x Spirit Stones' and 'Price rate: y%' texts

scenarios.title: Pub rebirth button and forge custom refine
scenarios.description: Pub and forge: the pub shows a Rebirth button only when town level and player grade allow it; a small-town forge opens the custom refine item selector. The test checks both (rebirth is not clicked here, see TX-03).
expected: Rebirth button shown exactly when the town/grade conditions allow it
Small town forge opens the custom refine item selector

scenarios.title: Storage fee and debt
scenarios.description: Storage fee and debt (UI + monthly part of TG-12): the storage shows value/fee; with a debt it shows red warnings; at month end the debt and fee are paid from the player's money. The test creates a debt of 1234 and runs the monthly handler.
steps: Travel to a town with storage
Set a debt of 1234, open the storage items
expected: Debt and fee paid from the player money

scenarios.title: Sell window: rate, town budget and over-budget block
scenarios.description: Selling to a shop: the sell window shows the rate and the town budget. A town cannot pay more than its budget: then the sell button is hidden and 'Over price' is shown. The test empties the budget to check the block, then restores it.
steps: Travel to a town with a shop
expected: Sell button hidden and 'Over price' when the town cannot pay

scenarios.title: Commission delivered by the monthly handler
scenarios.description: Commission delivery: when a commission is finished, the monthly handler gives the reward window, puts the items in the bag and removes the commission. The test creates a finished commission of 3 herbs and runs the month.
steps: Travel to a town with a bounty board
Add a finished commission of 3 herbs

scenarios.title: Team: NPC info, hire, monthly payment, dismiss
scenarios.description: Team (UI version of TG-09): from the NPC info the player hires an NPC, the team window shows the monthly payment, the monthly handler pays the member, then the player dismisses it. Team luck must be added and removed.
steps: Hire the NPC, open the team window
expected: Member in the team with the team luck
Monthly payment taken, member follows the master

scenarios.title: Become town master (trainer) and manage the town
scenarios.description: Town master: the player can become master of a town (here via the trainer) and gets a 'manage town' window plus a shop discount. The test makes the player master, opens the management window and checks the discount.
steps: Travel to a town with a shop

scenarios.title: Town rebuilds a destroyed building with its budget
scenarios.description: Town rebuild: when an original building of a town is destroyed, the town rebuilds it over the months using its budget. The test destroys one, gives budget, runs the monthly build and checks it is rebuilt and the cost paid.
steps: Travel to a town with a destroyable building
Give budget, run the monthly build until rebuilt
expected: Building rebuilt, cost paid from the budget

scenarios.title: Cultivate with spirit stones
scenarios.description: Cultivate with spirit stones: a button on the cultivation screen converts 10000 x grade spirit stones into exp (more with talent and basis). The test clicks it and checks money paid and exp gained.

scenarios.title: Qi in NPC info and Qi transfer
scenarios.description: Qi cultivation on NPCs: the NPC info shows its Qi and bonuses, and 'transfer Qi' moves part of the player's Qi to the NPC. The test sets Qi values, opens the NPC info and does a transfer.
steps: Set Qi of the player/NPC, open the NPC info
expected: Qi moved from the player to the NPC

scenarios.title: NPC growth over 24 months
scenarios.description: NPC growth: every month NPCs upgrade martial skills, craft artifacts and gain exp so they keep up with the player. The test runs 24 monthly ticks on one NPC and checks its martial exp and cultivation exp/grade increased.

scenarios.title: Buy from a shop: price rate, town budget, master discount
scenarios.description: Buying from a shop (vanilla shop with Taoist rules). The quantity dialog shows the town buy rate and its unit price must be base price x rate; confirming adds the paid money to the town budget; after becoming town master the unit price drops by the master discount.
scenarios.preconditions: Save loaded (a town with a shop where the player is not guardian)
steps: Travel to the town, open the shop
Open the quantity dialog for a 1000 item, buy 2
Become town master (trainer), open the dialog again
expected: Unit price = 1000 x buy rate, 'Price rate' text shown
Buy rate lowered by TownMReduceBuyRate, unit price follows

scenarios.title: Player market: VIP, register, my items, price, deals, sell, buy, barter, buy orders
scenarios.description: Player market end to end through its windows. Sell: buy VIP access (fee to the town), register a herb in the Register window, the same item cannot be registered twice, the listing is shown in My Items with its price, Up/Down change the price, an NPC offers, the offer is listed under Deals, the player opens that NPC deal and clicks Deal (money to the player, item to the NPC). Buy: an NPC lists a herb, Market shows that NPC, its sell list shows the herb, the player offers with Up (first offer = seller price) and the seller accepts (money to the NPC, item to the player). The monthly random parts (NPCs joining, accept chance) are not driven; the deals they lead to are. Additions: recent deal prices are recorded and shown; a new NPC offer on a player listing is notified once (and logged); a barter deal moves the item offered by the buyer to the seller; Buy Orders opens a window and the new-order item list; a buy order holds the spirit stones, is filled by an NPC owning the item (paid from the held stones) and a cancelled order is refunded; market events are in the Taoist log.
scenarios.preconditions: Save loaded, player market on (NoMarketItem off)
steps: Open the town market, buy VIP
Register a herb; register it again
My Items: select the listing, Up then Down
An NPC offers 123; Deals; open the NPC deal; Deal
An NPC lists a herb for 50; Market; open the NPC; select the herb; Up
The seller accepts the best offer
Buy Orders window, new order list
expected: VIP fee paid to the town budget, VIP listings open
Listing registered once (second registration refused), register window closed
Listing and its price shown in My Items; Up raises and Down lowers the price
The NPC is in the buyers list, its deal shows 123 spirit stones; money and items transferred, listing removed, deal drama shown
The NPC is in the sellers list, its herb is shown, player offer = 50
Player pays 50 and gets the herb, the NPC gets 50 and loses the herb, listing removed
One message line with the offer, none without a new offer
Window and item list with the herb
Herbs delivered, NPC paid, refund on cancel, logged

scenarios.title: Exchange items for sect contribution
scenarios.description: In the player's own sect an 'Exchange' button opens an item selector showing the monthly ratio; confirming gives contribution = item value / ratio, adds the value to the sect money and takes the items. A player without sect joins the nearest sect for the test and leaves it afterwards.
scenarios.preconditions: Save loaded (sect joined temporarily when the player has none)
steps: Join a sect if needed (SectNoExchange off for the test)

scenarios.title: Custom refine of an artifact: exp, level, adjustment quality, bonuses, progress, reroll
scenarios.description: Custom refine of an artifact (weapon) at a small-town forge, twice, through refine button -> item selector -> spirit stone selector -> OK. A small refine checks exp = stones x refine weapon / 40, the payment to the town budget and the result message. A large refine brings the artifact to refine level 100: the first adjustment slot unlocks (quality color, value above 0), the second still shows its requirement, the artifact Atk/Def bonuses grow and the artifact info window shows the refine level and Atk bonus. The forge shows the refine progress (exp between two levels, next slot at 200); an unlocked slot can be rerolled for spirit stones (a locked one cannot) in the reroll window.
scenarios.preconditions: Save loaded (an artifact is added to the bag, removed at the end)
steps: Travel to a small town with a forge, add an artifact
Refine with the stones needed for level 100
Check the adjustment slots and bonuses
expected: New artifact without refine exp, player refine weapon > 0
Exp gained = stones x refine weapon / 40, stones paid to the town budget, message 'level old -> new (+exp)'
Slot 1 unlocked with its quality and a value, slot 2 locked '(Req 200)', +Atk/+Def larger than at level 0
Artifact info shows 'Refine (level)' and the +Atk bonus
Exp between the level thresholds, text with the level and 200
Slot 1 rerolled and paid, slot 2 refused

scenarios.title: Repair a damaged god artifact
scenarios.description: Option AllowRepairGodWeapon: a damaged god artifact (devil demon) gets a Repair button that asks the cost, takes the money and repairs it. The artifact is enabled and damaged for the test and restored afterwards; when the option is off a temporary instance of the feature is used.
steps: Enable and damage the devil demon
expected: Artifact repaired, money paid, window closed

scenarios.title: Break through without items
scenarios.description: Option AllowUpgradeNaturally: with full exp the cultivation screen shows 'Break through'; clicking it moves the player to the next phase and clears the exp. Grade and exp are restored afterwards; when the option is off a temporary instance of the feature is used.
scenarios.preconditions: Save loaded (exp filled, grade restored after)
steps: Open the cultivation screen, click Break through

scenarios.title: Trainer hotkeys Ctrl+1/2/3
scenarios.description: The Ctrl+1/2/3 hotkeys (TrainerEvent.OnHotkey, called for the key presses) open the trainer on page 1/2/3, switch pages while it is open, and open it again after the window was closed with its close button. Only the 3 Input.GetKey lines are not covered.
scenarios.preconditions: Map screen (temporary trainer instance when the trainer is disabled)
steps: Close with the window button, Ctrl+1
expected: Trainer opens again after it was closed

scenarios.title: Expertise level of an equipped skill
scenarios.description: Expertise on a real equipped skill of the player: one use adds exp in the expected range (grade and insight scaled), enough exp raises the expertise level, and an ability with expertise gives stat bonuses. The skill exp is restored afterwards.
scenarios.preconditions: Save loaded, the player has an equipped skill
steps: Add the exp of one use
Add the exp of the next level
expected: Ability bonus grows with the level

scenarios.title: Int limits: growing values do not overflow
scenarios.description: Values that keep growing over a long game are int: they must stop at the int maximum instead of wrapping to a negative number or falling back to 0 (ParseHelper.Parse returns 0 on overflow). Checks expertise exp, a player property (AddProperty), spirit stones and the inflation of a big price; monster buffs and the damage pipeline are checked in TB-06. Every value is restored.
steps: Expertise exp near the max + one use

scenarios.title: Monthly town tax: NPC pays the town, or leaves
scenarios.description: Monthly town economy: an NPC staying in a town pays the town tax into the town budget and rests at the inn (HP back to max); an NPC who cannot pay the tax is sent out of the town.
steps: Put an NPC in a town
Run its monthly handler with money
expected: Money - tax, budget + tax, HP full

scenarios.title: Battle start: statistics reset, monsters buffed, humans shielded
scenarios.description: Battle start (watched in a battle you play, -WatchBattles): damage statistics reset, monsters are buffed by 'monsters stronger', humans get their mana shield. Screenshots at start and after 10 s show the shield bar and damage multiplier.
scenarios.preconditions: Run with -WatchBattles, then enter any battle
expected: Screenshots at start and after 10 s (shield bar, damage multiplier)

scenarios.title: Battle end: rewards logged, slice-life counter reset
scenarios.description: Battle end (watched, -WatchBattles): damage dealt/received is recorded, battle rewards are logged and the slice-of-life counter is reset (a battle breaks the 'no fighting' streak).

scenarios.title: Monster wave battle: join, kill, win, back to the map
scenarios.description: Monster wave battle (started by code): the player joins the monster wave attacking a town, kills 3 monsters, wins and returns to the map. Checks the battle features (buffed monsters, kill list, rewards, slice-life reset) in a real battle.
steps: Travel to a town, join its monster wave (code)
expected: Battle is a monster wave, monsters valid
Back on the map, slice-life counter reset

scenarios.title: NPC duel: start, defeat the NPC, back to the map
scenarios.description: NPC duel (started by code): a 1-vs-1 battle with an NPC that has its mana shield; the player defeats it and returns to the map.
steps: Start a duel with an NPC (code)

scenarios.title: Spiritlock circle: tortoises cannot move
scenarios.description: Spiritlock circle dungeon (started by code): Taoist makes the venerable tortoises and the circle unable to move. The test enters dungeon 7007 and checks their move speed is 0.

scenarios.title: Special monsters (shield, split) and monsters getting stronger
scenarios.description: Monster wave started by code, with the S&M special monster rate raised for the test: every common/elite monster has a shield and splits when killed; kills raise the 'monsters stronger' kill counter; a monster spawned after the growth counter rose has more HP than the same monster before.
scenarios.preconditions: Save loaded (special monster rate raised during the battle)
steps: Spawn the same monster after +100 growth ticks
expected: Spawned monster has more max HP
Split list cleared after the battle

scenarios.title: NPCs join battles, stalkers, challenge quest
scenarios.description: Real NPC duel started by code with, around the player, a friend, an enemy, a stalker and a hired team member (join rates 100% for the test). Friend and team member join on the player side, enemy and stalker on the other side; killing an opponent a grade above counts for the challenge quest; the monthly stalker handler moves stalkers next to the player. The stalker can be paid off: the player pays the fee to the stalker, its team leaves the battle and the pay-off is logged; the team member who fought beside the player gains intimacy after the battle.
scenarios.preconditions: Save loaded (join rates, relations and team changed for the test)
steps: Duel an NPC above the player grade
Wait for the NPCs to join
Check the team member intimacy after the battle
expected: Each NPC joins on the right side
Stalker removed from the list when it joins
Stalker moved next to the player
Fee paid to the stalker, stalker out of the battle, logged

scenarios.title: Trial of lightning: damage scaled on the player, properties after surviving
scenarios.description: Trial of lightning (dungeon 110081) started by code: the lightning units hit with a damage scaled on the player (attack x game level/grade factors - defense x thunder basis), and surviving the trial raises the player properties of the Trial role.

scenarios.title: Battle won: training growth and exp from damage
scenarios.description: A real duel won by the player. A big hit makes the training growth (properties grow with the total damage dealt) run many times: it must end quickly and raise Attack; winning gives exp computed from the damage dealt and received (clamped, no overflow). Exp and Attack are restored.
steps: Kill, win, back to the map
expected: Hit handled in < 3 s, Attack grew

scenarios.title: Battle lost without body reconstruction item: exp lost
scenarios.description: Real duel lost by the player (the player unit is killed by the opponent). Every lose option off and no body reconstruction item for the grade: the cultivation exp falls to the phase minimum. Player state restored.
steps: All lose options off, exp 500 above the minimum

scenarios.title: Battle lost with a body reconstruction item: item used, exp kept
scenarios.description: Real duel lost by the player (the player unit is killed by the opponent). At grade 4 with a body reconstruction item (1011721) the item is used instead of the exp. Grade and exp restored.

scenarios.title: Battle lost with lost items when die: items go to the killer
scenarios.description: Real duel lost by the player (the player unit is killed by the opponent). With LostItemWhenDie the sellable items are lost (each kept with a chance of luck/10 % + ring lock score) and the killer receives them.
steps: LostItemWhenDie on, 5 herb kinds in the bag

scenarios.title: Battle lost with lost money when die: spirit stones go to the killer
scenarios.description: Real duel lost by the player (the player unit is killed by the opponent). With LostMoneyWhenDie the player loses all its spirit stones and the killer gets them.

scenarios.title: Battle lost with lost lifespan when die: life drained to the killer
scenarios.description: Real duel lost by the player (the player unit is killed by the opponent). With LostLifespanWhenDie the player loses lifespan (at least 6 months x game level) and the killer gains half of it.

scenarios.title: Battle lost with auto save after lost: one month passes and the game saves
scenarios.description: Real duel lost by the player (the player unit is killed by the opponent). With AutoSaveAfterLostInBattle a month passes after the defeat (TimeSkipEvent.SkipTime(1)) and the game is saved without overlapping saves.
steps: Wait for the month and the save

scenarios.title: Skip 1 year with the map button
scenarios.description: Skip 1 year: the map button passes 12 months (one per second) and gives exp from MP/SP. After it: time +12 months, age follows the time, yearly price index saved, quest chains still valid. Changes the save (restored after the run).
scenarios.preconditions: Save loaded (changes the save, restored after the run)
steps: Click 'skip 1 year' on the map, confirm

scenarios.title: Currency reform when the price index passes the limit
scenarios.description: Currency reform: when the price index passes its limit, money is re-denominated (divided by 10000), town budgets are cut by 80%, the index is reset and the market is cleared. The test forces the index to the limit and runs the yearly handler. Changes the save (restored after the run).
steps: Set index to LIMIT and money 12,340,000

scenarios.title: Rebirth in the pub
scenarios.description: Rebirth (the action, see TG-22/TG-35): in the pub of a high-level town the player is reborn: grade reset to 1, rebirth counted, rebirth luck added. Changes the save (restored after the run).
scenarios.preconditions: Grade above the rebirth level, no sect (changes the save)
steps: Travel to a town of a high enough level, open the pub

scenarios.title: Slice-of-life quest: monthly counter, reset by battle, completion luck
scenarios.description: From game year 2 (runs after TX-01 skipped a year) the slice-of-life quest is active: each month without battle increments its counter, a battle resets it, and reaching the required count completes the level and gives its luck. Changes the save (restored after the run).
scenarios.preconditions: Game year >= 2 (after TX-01; changes the save)
steps: Set the count to required-1, run a month

scenarios.title: Month passes and the Taoist data is saved to disk
scenarios.description: One month passes through the world-run events (ModLib monthly tick, then ModLib saves the game). The Taoist caches written to disk (mod/nE7UL2/saves/<player>/*.json) must contain the values in memory, and two saves requested at the same time must not overlap (an overlapping save failed with FileNotFoundException and hung the game). Changes the save (restored after the run).
expected: Cache files written after the save with the same values (counters, expertise, price index, exchange ratio, market)
No FileNotFoundException, game not stuck in a save

scenarios.title: Yearly handlers: NPC born, speed units, town masters
scenarios.description: The OnYearly event of every Taoist feature runs once: a new NPC is born, speed-unit NPCs get +1 move speed, every town with guardians has a master, the yearly price index is saved. Changes the save (restored after the run).
expected: One more unit in the world
Every town with guardians has a master

scenarios.title: Battle lost with one-life: the character dies
scenarios.description: Real duel lost by the player (the player unit is killed by the opponent). With the one-life option the lifespan is set to 0 and a month passes: the character dies. It ends the character, so it runs last (TZ); the save is restored after the run.
scenarios.preconditions: Last scenario of the run (ends the character)

scenarios.title: Divine artifact hotkeys: bindings, map, battle
scenarios.description: With the 3 divine artifacts, Settings > Bindings has a row per artifact in the combat and map key lists (copies of the game rows). A click waits for a key; a key of the game is refused, a key of another artifact moves, Esc cancels, Backspace clears. On the map the artifact buttons are side by side and show their keys, a hotkey opens the artifact window. In a duel the buttons show their keys, the hotkeys are read every frame and use the artifact (its cooldown starts). Keys restored at the end.
scenarios.preconditions: Save loaded (the 3 artifacts are set for the test)
steps: Try the game artifact key, move a key, Esc, Backspace
Map: buttons and God Eye hotkey
Duel: buttons, God Eye and Devil Demon hotkeys
expected: 6 rows (combat + map) with the artifact names
Keys saved and shown in the rows
Game key refused, key moved, cancel/clear work
Buttons side by side showing 7/8/9, God Eye window opens
Battle buttons show 7/8/9 and are side by side, hotkeys read in battle, God Eye cooldown starts

scenarios.title: Damage calculation in a battle: button, hotkey, pause, last hits, recent foes
scenarios.description: In a duel: the battle screen has the 'Damage Calc' button under the damage multiplier (top centre, away from the skill bar); a hit dealt and a hit taken are recorded step by step, the foe becomes the target of the window and the newest recent cultivator with its numbers of that time (kept in the save); the hotkey opens the window (lines with icons, the foe as the target) and pauses the battle, page 2 shows the foe's card, the hotkey again closes it and the battle runs again.
steps: A hit dealt and a hit taken
expected: Both hits recorded with their steps; the foe recorded with ATK / DEF / HP / grade / date
Window open, battle paused, foe as the target, icons
The foe is still in the recent foes

scenarios.title: Random encounters: dramas, choices and rewards
scenarios.description: Random monthly encounters with choices: wounded cultivator (medicine: friendship + herb; rob: 30 % of his money), chess hermit (win: exp + stake; lose: the stake), hooded peddler (item / empty box / haggle: 30 % off or he leaves), collapsed cave (materials / spirit stones / injury), spirit beast cub (herb -> +luck; no herb), town festival (mood, cost to the town budget). The drama shows its options, the monthly handler opens one at 100 %, every result is checked with fixed rolls and written in the Taoist log.
steps: Resolve every encounter with fixed rolls
expected: Money/items/exp/luck/mood/HP change as described, result drama shown, results logged

scenarios.title: Drama texts: variants, chains and options
scenarios.description: The reworked dramas: each battle drama key has its variants (key_1, key_2...) and a random pick uses them; an NPC-join drama shows one of its texts; the Qi transfer drama goes on to its second line and its own option; the stalker drama offers 'fight' and 'pay them off (fee)'.
steps: Open the Qi drama and click on
expected: Expected variant counts, picks among them

scenarios.title: Bank loan: borrow, interest, overdue, collector, blacklist
scenarios.description: A bank loan from start to blacklist: the storage of a town with an account shows 'Bank loan' and opens the loan window; borrowing pays the player from the town budget (a second loan is refused); 3 % interest a month; a partial repayment goes to the budget; overdue: +5 % penalty and a reminder letter; then a debt collector: handing over takes money then items (-100 reputation); beating 2 collectors writes the debt off and blacklists the player (no loan, account closed, taxes x3 there).
scenarios.preconditions: Save loaded (account, budget and loan changed for the test, restored at the end)
steps: Borrow half the limit, try again
expected: Debt written off, blacklisted, account closed, taxes x3, logged

scenarios.title: Town master: tax statistics, called back to defend the town
scenarios.description: Tax statistics of a town count payers, income and residents who left, keep the previous month and are shown in the town management window. When the player's town is attacked far away, a drama calls the player back (rush back / trust the guardians); trusting simulates the war and logs it.
scenarios.preconditions: Save loaded (a town with a master)
steps: Record 2 payments and 1 leaver, then a new month
Call to defend, trust the guardians
expected: 150 from 2, 1 left; kept as last month

scenarios.title: Bounties: post, hunt, expire, wanted player, wanted list
scenarios.description: Bounties paid from a town budget: posting takes the reward from the budget (duplicates and rewards under the minimum refused); a hunter who wins kills the target and gets the reward; a failed hunt keeps the bounty; an expired bounty is refunded; a bounty on the player shows a notice and brings an ambush (fight / pay 1.5 x the reward to clear the name); the bounty board shows the wanted list as portraits and a portrait opens the NPC info with the first tab only and the bounty details; everything is logged.
scenarios.preconditions: Save loaded (a town with a bounty board and an NPC master)
steps: Post under the minimum, post, post again
Post on a 2nd NPC, failed hunt, expiry
Post on the player, hunt (ambush), clear the name
Open the bounty board, Wanted list
expected: Target dead, hunter paid, bounty done
Notice, ambush with 2 options, paid, town refunded, no longer wanted
The wanted NPC is listed, events logged

scenarios.title: S&M score (P): rewards, titles and records, rare encounter, start bonus, inheritance
scenarios.description: With the P of the save set for the test (restored at the end): 1. battle exp and loot x the reward multiplier (P / 2,000 %, -20 .. +50 %); 2. the title of the tier and P in the player info, the record of the character in the global records window (Taoist Settings > Score records); 3. the heavenly trial encounter only from 30,000 P (win: exp and an item, lose: HP, decline: nothing); 4. the start bonus of a new save (P / 10,000 ability points, P / 5 spirit stones), given once and logged; 5. a descendant keeps 100 % of the spirit stones at 0 P, 75 % at -10,000 P, 50 % at -20,000 P and below.
steps: Read the P of the save
Exp and loot at 40,000 P and -100,000 P
Possible encounters at 29,999 / 30,000 P, resolve the trial
expected: P = score of the S&M settings of the save
The character listed with its P
Trial only from 30,000 P; win / lose / decline
+5 ability points, +10,000 spirit stones, logged, once

scenarios.title: Damage calculation window, Taoist log dates, buy order icons
scenarios.description: The player info has the 'Damage Calc' button on the top edge, left of the close button (every tab), and the S&M score line at the top left; recent foes keep the 3 newest of each kind (the same foe replaced); the window has 2 pages: the stats with icons (not paused outside a battle), then the recent monsters and cultivators as cards with their picture, their numbers of that time and the damage both ways. The Taoist log writes the full year and month with an icon per entry; the buy orders window shows the icon of each item. Recent foes and orders restored.
steps: Record 4 cultivators, the first again, a monster
Add a buy order, open the buy orders
expected: Next to the close button, score at the top left
3 kept, newest first, replaced not added, monster recorded
A card with a picture per foe, damage both ways

scenarios.title: Taoist log in the month log of the game
scenarios.description: Taoist log entries are also written in the month log of the game; the game buffers the lines of the month and writes them when the month ends. An entry is added, one month passes, the month log window shows it.

scenarios.title: Family, continue as a descendant, seclusion
scenarios.description: Two NPCs marry; a child born 16 years ago grows up into an NPC (surname of the father, parents linked, family window). The player marries and has a grown-up child who takes over the player (S&M Continue as a descendant). An offered seclusion of 1 year passes the time (world simulated) and ends with the summary drama.
steps: Marry two NPCs, add a child born 16 years ago, run the monthly handler
Open the family window of the father
Marry the player, add a grown-up child
Offer the inheritance, choose the child, then keep the child's own techniques
Offer a 1-year seclusion and enter it
expected: Married both ways; child NPC of 16 years with the father surname and linked parents

The player has the name, age, reputation and techniques of the heir; the heir NPC is gone; next generation; a friendship of the old player halved, an enmity in full; its town seat and the bounty on it ended
12 months passed, more exp, summary drama, family and seclusion entries in the Taoist log

scenarios.title: Time skip: timings (full simulation, 10 years) and interruption
scenarios.description: Measures the time skip (the player hidden: no NPC drama): 3 months with the month run of the game every month (full simulation), then 10 years (the mods every 10 months, 4 month runs of the game). Then a 2-year skip is interrupted by a drama: it stops early.
steps: Skip 3 months with the full simulation
Skip 2 years and open a drama during it
expected: 3 months passed, 3 month runs of the game; timing in the infos
120 months passed, 4 month runs of the game; timing in the infos; loading window closed
The skip stops before 24 months, interrupted, loading window closed

scenarios.title: Household upkeep, gifts and accounts
scenarios.description: The player has a companion, a grown-up child and a young one. The monthly upkeep is paid from the money, then from the bank storage stones; what is left is unpaid and upsets the family. A member brings spirit stones and an item to the bank storage and takes the item back. The map button opens the accounts window.
steps: Marry the player, add a grown-up child and a 2-year-old
Pay the upkeep with enough money
Pay the upkeep with half of it in the storage and no money
Gift stones, gift an item, take it back
Check the map button, open the accounts
expected: Companion and child are members, one child not grown up
Storage stones used, the rest unpaid, the companion's intimacy lower
Stones and the item in the storage, then the item gone; Taoist log entries
The Family button is on the map
Members listed, an entry with the child, the monthly upkeep shown

The test opens the line, answers every drama (first option; an option whose condition is not met: the next one), wins the battles at once (StoryEvent.NoBattles) and opens every act without waiting for its years / realm (StoryEvent.NoGates).
